query.statement: SELECT SALES_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, SALES_ORDER_NAME, CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PLAN_START_DATE, PLAN_END_DATE, PLAN_QTY, DELIVERED_QTY, OWNER_ID, STATUS, IS_HOLD FROM SLS_SALES_ORDER WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) AND (@customerId IS NULL OR CUSTOMER_ID = @customerId) ORDER BY PLAN_START_DATE DESC

SELECT SALES_REQUEST_ID, SALES_REQUEST_NAME, SALES_ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, REQUEST_DATE, REQUEST_QTY, STATUS FROM SLS_SALES_REQUEST WHERE (@salesOrderId IS NULL OR SALES_ORDER_ID = @salesOrderId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY REQUEST_DATE DESC

-- 그리드 표준 편집(upsert) — PK 충돌 시 UPDATE(CREATED_*는 최초 등록 정보 보존). INSERT INTO SLS_SALES_ORDER (SALES_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, SALES_ORDER_NAME, CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PLAN_QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@salesOrderId, @plantId, @salesOrderName, @customerId, @productId, @planQty, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow) ON CONFLICT(SALES_ORDER_ID) DO UPDATE SET PLANT_ID = excluded.PLANT_ID, SALES_ORDER_NAME = excluded.SALES_ORDER_NAME, CUSTOMER_ID = excluded.CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID = excluded.PRODUCT_ID, PLAN_QTY = excluded.PLAN_QTY, UPDATED_BY = excluded.UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT
UPDATE SLS_SALES_ORDER SET STATUS = 'Confirmed', UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHERE SALES_ORDER_ID = @salesOrderId AND STATUS = 'Draft'
UPDATE SLS_SALES_ORDER SET STATUS = 'Closed', UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHERE SALES_ORDER_ID = @salesOrderId AND STATUS IN ('Producing', 'Delivered')
